seo_title: Tessa at Katy Reviews: Resident Pros and Cons
description: Tessa at Katy reviews, summarized: friendly staff and resort amenities versus elevator outages and move-out charges. See the pros, cons, and tour tips.
excerpt: Looking for honest and detailed Tessa at Katy reviews? You’re in the right place. This compiles insights from recent reviews to provide a well-rounded look at what it’s really like to live at Tessa at Katy, a modern apartment community located in the heart of Katy, Texas. Nestled at 150 Cobia Dr, this property promotes […]
content:
Tessa at Katy reviews are sharply split: residents praise the friendly leasing staff, clean and spacious apartments, and resort-style amenities, but many also report long elevator outages, upkeep problems, and surprise charges. The community at 150 Cobia Dr held a 3.8-star Google rating at the time of writing. Below we break down what residents love, what they flag, and the questions to ask before you lease.

Note: This summary is based on publicly available Google reviews and reflects individual renter experiences. The 3.8-star average was accurate when this article was published and may have changed since.

About Tessa at Katy

Tessa at Katy is a modern apartment community in the heart of Katy, Texas, close to shopping and dining at LaCenterra at Cinco Ranch. It markets a luxury lifestyle with stylish interiors and resort-style shared spaces, and the neighborhood blends suburban calm with easy access to everyday conveniences. If you are new to the area, our guide to apartments in Katy covers the bigger picture.

Apartment features

  • Chef-inspired kitchens with granite countertops, two-tone cabinetry, and under-cabinet lighting
  • Farmhouse sinks and stainless steel appliances
  • Hardwood-style flooring and modern paint finishes
  • Private patios or balconies
  • In-unit washer and dryer setups
  • Mud rooms, private yards, and computer desks in select units

Community amenities

  • Resort-style swimming pool with sun shelves
  • Fitness center plus yoga and spin studios
  • Entertainment room with a media center and sports simulator
  • Urban clubhouse with a business center and private offices
  • Grilling and dining areas
  • Greenbelt with a walking path
  • Expansive dog park and pet washing station
  • Indoor children's play area
  • Covered parking

Positive Tessa at Katy reviews

Despite the critical reviews, plenty of residents have had good experiences. Four themes come up repeatedly.

Friendly, professional office staff

Residents frequently commend the office team, and Aubriana, Jessica, and Maggie are mentioned by name for their help during tours and leasing.

"The office staff have been very nice and professional every time I have to communicate with them."

"Jessica made us feel right at home from day one."

Spacious, clean apartments

Reviewers like the roomy floor plans and say units were clean at move-in.

"The apartment I just moved into was so clean, which I appreciate so much."

"It is spacious and feels like home."

Quick application and move-in

"The application process was extremely easy and fast. I got approved within 2 days."

Community events

Some residents appreciate the organized activities and community feel.

"This past October we truly enjoyed the pumpkin painting. We can't wait for them to host another activity."

Negative Tessa at Katy reviews

The critical reviews are numerous and some are serious. These are the issues prospective renters should weigh most carefully.

Elevator outages

Elevator reliability is the most common complaint, particularly in Building 3. Residents describe extended outages that affected mobility, especially for people with medical needs.

"I went over 6 months without the elevator being fixed."

"I couldn't access my apartment for a total of 8 weeks."

Upkeep and cleanliness

Complaints include dirty hallways and carpets, broken gym equipment, overflowing trash, and pests.

"It's always dog poop and trash around the complex."

"Spider webs on balconies and even inside my apartment."

Security

One review describes a stranger unlocking a door with a key fob, which raises understandable concerns about access control.

"A stranger was able to unlock my apartment door with a key fob."

Management turnover and communication

"Three management company changes in two years."

"Despite multiple emails and calls, I was met with complete radio silence."

Move-out charges and lease complications

Several reviewers report unexpected move-out charges, unexplained "conditional" approvals, and fees they did not think applied to them.

"Charged over $2,000 after moving out despite giving 3 months notice."

"Charged a pet fee when we never had any pets."

Tessa at Katy pros and cons

ProsCons
Friendly, professional leasing staffLong elevator outages reported, especially in Building 3
Spacious, clean units with farmhouse sinks and in-unit laundryComplaints about trash, pests, and dirty common areas
Resort-style pool, sports simulator, yoga and spin studiosA reported key fob security incident
Dog park, pet wash station, and greenbelt trailFrequent management changes and slow communication
Close to LaCenterra at Cinco RanchDisputed move-out charges and fees

How to vet Tessa at Katy on your tour

Because experiences here vary so widely, a careful tour matters more than usual. A few practical steps:

  1. Ask about the elevators. If you are considering an upper floor, ask whether the elevators in your building are working, how outages are handled, and how long recent repairs took.
  2. Walk the common areas. Look at hallways, trash areas, the gym, and the dog park, not just the model unit.
  3. Ask who manages the property now. Given reported turnover, confirm the current management company and how to reach them after hours.
  4. Get fees in writing. Request a full list of monthly and move-out fees, and document your unit's condition with photos at move-in.
  5. Confirm pet rules. The community allows up to two pets, but check breed and size restrictions and make sure no pet fees are added if you do not have one.

Frequently asked questions

What amenities does Tessa at Katy offer?

Amenities include a resort-style pool with sun shelves, a fitness center, yoga and spin studios, an entertainment room with a media center and sports simulator, grilling areas, a greenbelt walking path, a dog park, a business center and clubhouse, and an indoor children's play area. If amenities like these are on your list, see our roundups of Houston apartments with a rooftop pool and apartments with a golf simulator.

Is Tessa at Katy pet-friendly?

Yes. Up to two pets are allowed per apartment, and there is a dog park and a pet washing station. Confirm breed and size restrictions with the leasing office.

What are the most common complaints in Tessa at Katy reviews?

The most frequent issues are long-term elevator malfunctions, inconsistent maintenance and cleanliness, pests, management turnover, and unexpected move-out charges.

What is the Google rating for Tessa at Katy?

It held a 3.8-star Google rating at the time of writing. Ratings shift as new reviews come in, so check recent reviews before you decide.

Where is Tessa at Katy located?

The community is at 150 Cobia Dr in Katy, Texas, near the shopping and dining at LaCenterra at Cinco Ranch.

Our take on Tessa at Katy

Tessa at Katy has real strengths: attractive design, spacious units, a deep amenity list, and staff who earn praise by name. The recurring reports about elevators, upkeep, and management responsiveness are hard to ignore, though, so inspect thoroughly and ask direct questions before you commit.

The community at 680 W Sam Houston Pkwy S, Houston, TX 77042 held a 4.2-star Google rating at the time of writing.

We pulled the most common praise and concerns from Google reviews so you can decide whether these apartments and townhomes fit your priorities before you tour.

Camden Holly Springs at a Glance

Camden Holly Springs mixes apartments and townhomes with one-, two-, and three-bedroom layouts. Here are the key details from the property and resident reviews.

Inside the apartments

  • Spacious kitchens with granite countertops, custom cabinetry, and stainless steel appliances
  • Wood-style flooring
  • Large soaking tubs and walk-in closets
  • Private patios
  • Built-in desks in select units, handy for a home office

If a dedicated work nook matters to you, see our roundup of Houston apartments with study spaces.

Community amenities and tech

  • Resort-style pool with WiFi and a separate lap pool
  • 24-hour fitness center and indoor sports court
  • Outdoor kitchen and social lounge
  • Fenced dog park and pet grooming station, plus on-demand pet care through Spruce

  • Technology package with internet up to 800 Mbps and 140+ TV channels including HBO, with app-based Xfinity TV access

What Residents Love About Camden Holly Springs

Responsive management and maintenance

The maintenance and management teams earn the most consistent praise. Residents say work orders are often handled within 24 hours, and team members such as Mario, Luci, Stephanie, Kat, and Jennifer are named for being respectful and responsive.

“I would like to commend the management… Mario installed the new dishwasher and was very respectful of my home and time.”

“The front office is very personal and very professional… Maintenance is on point with any and everything I need.”

Clean, modern homes and grounds

Reviewers like the stylish interiors, the well-kept common areas, and a leasing process they describe as smooth.

“Beautiful modern clean apartments, easy to lease, spot on maintenance… I’ve been here over a year and I still love these apartments.”

A friendly, quiet community

Many residents mention courteous neighbors and a calm atmosphere that feels removed from the bustle of the city.

“Every neighbor I’ve run into is so friendly and nice. The leasing office is a joy.”

Thoughtful perks

Garages and townhome options add flexibility, and one reviewer appreciated that Camden brought in food trucks for residents during Hurricane Beryl.

“During hurricane Beryl, Camden brought food trucks to feed us when we had no power.”

Pet-friendly and connected

With up to three pets allowed, a fenced dog park, and a pet grooming station, this is one of the more pet-focused communities we see. The smart locks and bundled internet and TV package are a bonus for tech-minded renters.

Common Complaints in Camden Holly Springs Reviews

Crime and security

The most serious concerns involve safety. Residents report car break-ins, theft, peeping toms, gates left broken, and too few security cameras in useful places, even though the property uses patrols.

“Sadly break-ins just increased! Gates damaged/broken for more than a week!”

“No security cameras, only a few, none are placed in useful places.”

Rent increases and value

Several reviewers say rent goes up every year and question whether the increases match the level of upkeep and service.

“Apartment management has the nerve to raise rent every single year, despite the declining conditions.”

Parking limits

The policy allows one parking sticker per leaseholder. Households with more vehicles are told to rent a garage, and residents say visitor spots fill up as a result.

“They’ll only allow 1 parking sticker per leaseholder… visitors will never have anywhere to park.”

Inconsistent office interactions

While many staff are praised, some reviewers describe certain office team members as condescending or unhelpful.

Pests, fees, and administrative issues

  • Pests and evictions: One resident reported a roach infestation and a three-day notice to vacate over a lease violation, plus withheld mail and packages.
  • Identity verification: An out-of-state person said someone leased a unit using their information, and they struggled to get a timely response.
  • Admin fee refunds: Applicants reported a $300 admin fee charged before approval and weeks of follow-up to get it back after a denial.

Pros and Cons Summary

ProsCons
Fast, respectful maintenance (often within 24 hours)Reports of break-ins, theft, and broken gates
Granite counters, full-size washer/dryer, built-in desksLimited security cameras
Garages and townhome optionsOne parking sticker per leaseholder
Up to three pets, dog park, grooming stationAnnual rent increases
Smart locks and bundled internet/TVAdmin fee refund and office communication complaints

Is Camden Holly Springs Right for You?

Camden Holly Springs delivers upscale finishes, a strong maintenance team, and some of the best pet amenities in the area. If you have one car or plan to rent a garage, and you value a quiet community, it is worth a tour.

If security is a top priority, ask the leasing office about recent gate repairs, camera coverage, and patrol schedules, and visit in the evening to get a feel for the parking lots. Get the admin fee refund policy in writing before you apply. If parking is a sticking point, compare Houston apartments with parking, and pet owners can browse more pet-friendly Houston apartments.

This review is based on Google reviews from renters and residents and reflects their personal experiences. The 4.2-star rating was accurate at the time of writing.

Frequently asked questions

What floor plans does Camden Holly Springs offer?

One-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments and townhomes. Select units include built-in desks for a home office.

Is Camden Holly Springs pet-friendly?

Yes. Up to three pets are allowed per apartment, with a $500 non-refundable fee and $30 monthly pet rent per pet. Residents get a fenced dog park, a grooming station, and access to Spruce pet care.

How does parking work?

Each leaseholder gets one parking sticker. Residents who need more parking are encouraged to rent a garage, which some tenants with multiple vehicles or frequent visitors find inconvenient.

Is Camden Holly Springs safe?

The property has patrols and smart lock features, but several reviews mention theft, break-ins, and limited camera coverage. Tour at night and ask management what security improvements are planned.

What is included in the technology package?

Internet up to 800 Mbps, more than 140 TV channels including HBO, and app-based access through Xfinity TV.

title: East End Lofts Reviews: What EaDo Renters Really Say
seo_title: East End Lofts Reviews: Pros, Cons & Fees to Know
description: East End Lofts reviews from EaDo renters: loft features, staff praise, fee disputes, and noise complaints, plus the questions to ask before you apply.
excerpt: If you’re searching for a new place to live in Houston’s vibrant EaDo neighborhood, it’s essential to know what current and former residents really think. This article dives into East End Lofts reviews from real renters, offering an honest, well-rounded look at the apartment community located at 2115 Runnels St, Houston, TX 77003. With a […]
content:
East End Lofts reviews are genuinely split. Residents love the converted-warehouse lofts, the staff, and the monthly events, but a group of applicants and tenants report fee refund disputes, communication gaps, and a few serious maintenance problems. The community is at 2115 Runnels St, Houston, TX 77003, in EaDo, and held a 4.2-star Google rating at the time of writing.

Here's what renters say on both sides, plus the questions worth asking before you pay any fees.

About East End Lofts: A Converted Warehouse in EaDo

East End Lofts is a historic former warehouse turned into loft-style apartments in Houston's EaDo neighborhood, just east of downtown Houston. Expect exposed brick, wood beams, industrial windows, and high ceilings, with modern finishes layered in.

DetailWhat we found
Address2115 Runnels St, Houston, TX 77003
NeighborhoodEaDo (East Downtown)
Google rating4.2 stars, based on 13 reviews at the time of writing
Floor plansRenovated studio, 1-, 2-, and 3-bedroom lofts
PetsPet-friendly, with a dog park

Inside the lofts

  • Open-concept layouts with high ceilings and exposed ductwork
  • Polished concrete or refinished wood flooring
  • Full-size washers and dryers
  • Private patios or balconies
  • Granite countertops, double vanities, oval soaking tubs, and pendant lighting in select homes

Community amenities

  • Private outdoor pool
  • 24-hour fitness center
  • Controlled access gates and covered parking
  • Courtyard and dog park
  • Business center and package room
  • Lounge with billiards
  • Flexible rent payment options

What Residents Love About East End Lofts

The positive East End Lofts reviews keep coming back to the building's character and the people who run it.

Friendly, responsive staff

Many residents describe management and maintenance as approachable and quick. Some long-term tenants say the staff is the main reason they renewed.

"The entire management team is great and very helpful. The maintenance team is responsive and flexible."

"Maintenance always comes the same day service was requested or the following day."

Monthly events and a neighborly feel

Residents praise the monthly gatherings as fun and well run. For newcomers, these events make it easier to meet people and help the building feel more like a neighborhood.

Long-term satisfaction

One tenant had lived at the property for 14 months and was preparing to sign another lease, crediting the management team. Another called it "one of the best places where I've lived."

"The management is my favorite part… very knowledgeable and the maintenance is excellent."

Industrial-chic design

The mix of historic character and modern features is a big draw. With studio through three-bedroom layouts, one reviewer said there's "something for everyone."

Common Complaints in East End Lofts Reviews

The critical reviews focus less on the lofts themselves and more on the leasing process and follow-through.

Application and admin fee disputes

This is the most repeated complaint. Several applicants say they were told, verbally or by text, that fees would be refunded if they were denied or chose not to move forward, then never received the refund and stopped hearing back from the office. Some reviewers said they escalated complaints to the Houston Apartment Association.

"They took our $200 administration fee and told us it would be reimbursed if we didn't qualify. After denial, they went completely silent."

Units shown that weren't available

One applicant said they were shown a specific floor plan, told it was available, and encouraged to apply, only to learn afterward that it was occupied. Their request to refund the $275 application fee was denied, and they said the same unit was later reposted online.

Slow or missing communication

Multiple tenants and applicants say emails went unanswered and calls were ignored, especially after fees were paid or during urgent maintenance issues.

A serious sewage problem

One resident described repeated sewage backups through the bathtub drain that made the bathroom unusable. They said the problem was never fully resolved, they ended their lease early, and the account was later sent to collections. It's unclear how widespread the issue is, but it's worth asking about plumbing history in older converted buildings.

Late-night trash noise

At least one resident said trash pickup often happened between 2 AM and 4 AM, along with dumpsters being moved between the garage and outdoor areas several days a week. If you work from home or sleep lightly, ask where your unit sits relative to the trash route.

Charges for services not yet active

A few tenants say they were billed for internet that wasn't available at move-in, without a clear timeline for when it would work.

East End Lofts Pros and Cons

ProsCons
Unique historic loft architectureReported fee refund disputes
Staff and maintenance praised by many residentsUnanswered emails and calls for some applicants
Monthly resident eventsOne report of unresolved sewage backups
Studio through 3-bedroom options with in-unit laundryEarly-morning trash pickup noise
Pool, gym, dog park, and billiards loungeInternet billed before it was available

How to Protect Yourself Before You Apply

  • Get fee terms in writing. Ask whether application and admin fees are refundable, under what conditions, and have that stated in an email or the application itself.
  • Confirm the exact unit. Ask for the unit number and written confirmation that it's available before you pay.
  • Ask about service start dates. Confirm when internet and any bundled services will be active and when billing begins.
  • Tour at different times. Visiting in the evening or early morning tells you more about noise than a midday tour.
  • Talk to current residents if you can, and document your unit's condition with photos at move-in.

Working with a locator also helps. Our apartment locating process is built around getting clear answers on fees and availability before you commit.

Is East End Lofts Right for You?

East End Lofts is a mixed bag. The lofts are visually striking, many residents love the staff and community events, and the EaDo location and amenity list give it real appeal. At the same time, the negative reviews point to poor communication, fee disputes, and some unresolved maintenance problems.

If you love loft living, tour in detail, get every promise in writing, and ask plenty of questions. If you'd like to compare it with other lofts and studio apartments in Houston, it pays to see a few options side by side.

Disclaimer: This summary is based on 13 Google reviews for East End Lofts and reflects the experiences of individual residents and applicants. The 4.2-star rating was recorded at the time of publication and may change.

Frequently Asked Questions

What floor plans does East End Lofts offer?

Renovated loft-style studios and one-, two-, and three-bedroom units, with open layouts, high ceilings, exposed ductwork, and polished concrete or refinished wood floors.

Are application fees refundable at East End Lofts?

This is the most disputed topic in the reviews. Several applicants say they were promised refunds that never came. Before paying, ask for the refund policy in writing.

Is the staff responsive?

Reviews are mixed. Many residents praise quick, friendly maintenance and management, while others report unanswered emails and calls, especially during the application process.

Have there been noise or maintenance issues?

Yes. One resident reported late-night trash pickup and dumpster noise, and another described recurring sewage backups. It's unclear how widespread either issue is, so ask about both on your tour.

Is East End Lofts pet-friendly?

Yes. The community is pet-friendly and has an on-site dog park. Ask the leasing office for current pet fees and restrictions.

title: Heights West End Reviews: Pros, Cons, and Resident Experiences
seo_title: Heights West End Reviews: Pros & Cons From Residents
description: Heights West End reviews: residents love the walkable Heights location but cite security and maintenance issues. See the full pros, cons, and tour tips.
excerpt: Located in the vibrant neighborhood of the Houston Heights, Heights West End at 4040 Koehler St, Houston, TX 77007 is an apartment community that boasts an enviable location with proximity to restaurants, shops, and gyms. With an overall Google rating of 3.8 stars, it stands as a property with both loyal fans and disappointed critics. […]
content:
Heights West End reviews are a true mixed bag: residents love the walkable Houston Heights location and spacious layouts, but many recent reviews describe security lapses, maintenance delays, and a drop in service after a 2022 management change. At the time of writing, the community at 4040 Koehler St held a 3.8-star Google rating. Here’s what renters praise, what they warn about, and what to ask on your tour.

Disclaimer: This article summarizes Google reviews and reflects the opinions of renters. The 3.8-star overall rating was accurate at the time of writing and may change.

Heights West End Overview

DetailHeights West End
Address4040 Koehler St, Houston, TX 77007
NeighborhoodHouston Heights, near the Washington Corridor
Floor plansStudio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom
Walk Score83
Google rating3.8 stars (at the time of writing)
Housing programParticipates in the City of Houston’s Essential Housing Program

Apartment Features and Community Amenities

Units come with stainless steel appliances, in-home washers and dryers, quartz countertops, and wood-like flooring. Community amenities include:

  • Swimming pool
  • Outdoor firepit and grills
  • Business center and fitness center
  • Parking garage and fob-access elevators

Location and Commute

With a Walk Score of 83, residents can reach the Houston trail system, nightlife, the Washington Corridor, and the Heart of the Heights easily. Downtown Houston, the Medical Center, and the Galleria are all within a reasonable commute.

Essential Housing Program

Heights West End participates in the City of Houston’s Essential Housing Program, which offers well-located housing at accessible rents for moderate- to middle-income workers such as teachers, restaurant workers, and first responders. The program is monitored by the Houston Housing Authority. If you think you might qualify, ask the leasing office how eligibility works, and see our guide to income-restricted apartments in Houston for similar options.

What Residents Like: Positive Heights West End Reviews

Smooth Move-Ins and Friendly Staff

Several residents praised an easy leasing and move-in process. One reviewer said Ivan Moncada made their transition professional and stress-free, answering every question and handing over a spotless apartment. Another tenant called Nani at the front office and the rest of the staff friendly, courteous, and quick to follow up on maintenance requests.

Clean Common Areas and Pet-Friendly Perks

Some reviews describe the common areas, pool, and gym as clean and well kept. Pet owners appreciated events like Yappy Hour and the new rooftop dog park, which helped build a sense of community.

Spacious Layouts

Tenants liked the large bathrooms, ample closet space, and kitchens with islands and plenty of storage. Carpet-free units were a plus for many, and one reviewer raved about their top-floor corner unit with downtown Houston views.

A Location People Love

The Heights location earns near-universal praise. Residents mention walking to Sprouts, gyms, and restaurants, and one said the location alone made it worth it despite minor inconveniences.

Flexible Exits Under Past Management

A resident who had to leave early for personal reasons said Yolanda made both move-in and move-out easy. Another noted that during KnightVest Management’s tenure, staff handled a lease termination professionally after a job layoff.

What Residents Warn About: Negative Heights West End Reviews

Security Lapses

Several residents reported vehicle theft, break-ins, and even an armed robbery within the complex. Reviewers claimed that floor cameras had not worked for months and that garage doors and gates stayed broken, and many described management’s response as slow or dismissive.

Maintenance and Cleanliness

Many reviews mention AC units, dryers, and doors left unrepaired for weeks or months. Others complained about the valet trash service leaving residue in the building, overflowing garbage cans, and dirty hallways, with some reporting gnats and roaches.

Customer Service and Fee Disputes

Dissatisfied residents describe a leasing office that can be rude, dismissive, or unresponsive. Some accused management of double charging fees and towing guests’ cars without warning. Others alleged discriminatory treatment by staff that they believed could violate the Fair Housing Act.

Decline After the 2022 Management Change

A recurring pattern: residents say service and upkeep declined noticeably after management changed in early 2022. Some who had previously praised the community said they broke their leases as conditions worsened.

Pests and Mold Allegations

The most serious claims involve roach and flea infestations and black mold. In one case, a tenant said management never fully fixed the problem despite repeated complaints and released them from the lease only after prolonged exposure.

Heights West End Pros and Cons

Pros residents mentionCons residents mention
Walkable Heights location (Walk Score 83)Reports of theft, break-ins, and broken gates or cameras
Spacious layouts, big closets, kitchen islandsSlow repairs on AC, dryers, and doors
Pet perks like Yappy Hour and a rooftop dog parkTrash, cleanliness, and pest complaints
Some standout staff membersService decline since the early-2022 management change
Essential Housing Program participationFee and towing disputes

Questions to Ask on Your Heights West End Tour

  • Are the cameras, garage doors, and gates working right now, and how quickly are they repaired when they break?
  • What is the typical turnaround on maintenance requests, especially AC?
  • How does pest control work, and how often is it scheduled?
  • What is the guest parking and towing policy?
  • Can I see the exact unit I would lease?

Focus on the most recent reviews, since several residents say conditions changed after the management transition, and talk to current tenants if you can.

Frequently asked questions

What is the Google rating for Heights West End?

At the time of writing, Heights West End held a 3.8-star Google rating, with praise for location and layouts and complaints about safety, maintenance, and customer service.

What amenities does Heights West End offer?

A swimming pool, outdoor firepit and grills, a business center, a fitness center, a parking garage, and fob-access elevators. Units include stainless steel appliances, quartz countertops, and in-home washers and dryers.

Is Heights West End part of the Essential Housing Program?

Yes. It participates in the City of Houston’s Essential Housing Program, which offers accessible rents for moderate- to middle-income workers and is monitored by the Houston Housing Authority.

What are the main complaints in Heights West End reviews?

Break-ins and theft, slow maintenance, pests, poor customer service, and a decline in conditions after the management change in early 2022.

Is Heights West End in a walkable area?

Yes. It has a Walk Score of 83 and sits near trails, restaurants, the Washington Corridor, and the Heart of the Heights.

Compare Heights Apartments Before You Sign

Heights West End offers a great location with real trade-offs. To compare it with other Heights communities, search Houston apartments on our map or talk to a Houston Apartments locator for a free shortlist. Lease through us and you can get up to $500 back.

title: Pearl Greenway Reviews: Pros and Cons From Real Residents
seo_title: Pearl Greenway Reviews: Pros & Cons From Residents
description: Pearl Greenway reviews from real residents: luxury units, fast maintenance, and a great Upper Kirby location, plus security and communication red flags.
excerpt: When searching for the right apartment in Houston, reviews from actual residents can be the most revealing source of truth. Pearl Greenway, located in the highly desirable Greenway-Upper Kirby neighborhood, has garnered attention and reviews for its luxury aesthetics, central location, and upscale amenities. But how does it really stack up according to the people […]
content:
Pearl Greenway reviews from residents are a tale of two experiences. Renters love the Greenway-Upper Kirby location, the upscale units, and a maintenance team that often fixes things the same day, but communication, move-in condition, and garage security draw repeated complaints. Below is a clear breakdown of both sides, based on public Google reviews, so you know what to ask before you sign.

Address: 3788 Richmond Ave., Houston, TX 77046
Overall rating: 4.1 stars at the time of writing

Pearl Greenway at a Glance

CategoryDetails from the property and reviews
NeighborhoodGreenway-Upper Kirby, about 10 minutes from The Galleria and 15 minutes from downtown
Floor plansOne and two bedrooms, 650 to 1,719 square feet
InteriorsChef-inspired kitchens, quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances; select units add built-in computer desks, private studies, separate tubs and showers, floor-to-ceiling windows, and balconies with city views
TechUSB charging outlets, iPod docking stations, integrated surround sound
AmenitiesClubhouse with coffee bar and cyber cafe, business center with Apple computers, Platinum Athletic Club, Vegas-style resort pool with sun deck and private cabanas, grilling areas, shaded dog park
Rating4.1 stars (at the time of writing)

What Residents Like About Pearl Greenway

A Central Location in Greenway-Upper Kirby

The location scores highly across Pearl Greenway reviews. Residents mention quick highway access and being close to restaurants, bars, parks, and shopping. It is about 10 minutes from The Galleria and 15 minutes from downtown Houston, which suits professionals who split time between both.

Upscale Apartment Features

The one- and two-bedroom floor plans range from 650 to 1,719 square feet, with chef-inspired kitchens, quartz countertops, and stainless steel appliances. Select homes include built-in computer desks, private studies, separate tubs and showers, floor-to-ceiling windows, and private balconies with city views. Tech touches like USB outlets, iPod docks, and integrated surround sound are standard.

Resort-Style Community Amenities

Residents get a large clubhouse with a coffee bar and cyber cafe, a business center with Apple computers, and the Platinum Athletic Club with multiple rooms of interactive equipment. The Vegas-style resort pool has a shallow-water sun deck and private cabanas with TVs, and there are outdoor grilling areas for weekend cookouts.

Fast, Professional Maintenance

This is one of the most consistent compliments. Many residents say requests are handled quickly, often the same day when submitted early, and 24/7 maintenance covers emergencies.

Friendly Leasing Staff

Joanne is praised repeatedly for going above and beyond, including staying late to finish paperwork and helping new tenants settle in. Stacey is also recognized for her professionalism.

Pet-Friendly and Eco-Minded

The enclosed, shaded dog park has play obstacles, a splash fountain, a dog wash station, and seating for owners. Residents say it is cleaned regularly and stocked with waste bags. Door-to-door recycling pickup and an on-site recycling center round things out.

Common Complaints and Red Flags

Communication Breakdowns

The most common frustration is slow or inconsistent communication. Reviewers describe unanswered calls, ignored voicemails, and emails that took days or weeks to get a reply. Some received conflicting information from different staff members, and a few residents say reaching management stayed difficult after move-in.

Disorganized Applications and Move-Ins

Several reviews describe the application and move-in process as stressful, with miscommunication causing delays and confusion over lease terms and apartment readiness. One reviewer canceled their application because of the leasing office's lack of urgency.

Units Not Clean at Move-In

Some tenants arrived to dusty blinds, dirty cabinets, grimy floors, and unclean bathrooms. One resident hired a professional cleaner after management could not provide cleaning over a holiday weekend.

Garage Security and Theft

Even though it is a gated community, long-term residents report car break-ins, stolen vehicles, and tire thefts inside the parking garage. Some say management did not share surveillance footage with authorities, and one tenant's notice to neighbors on the community bulletin board was reportedly removed.

Surprise Move-Out Charges

Former residents mention unexpected charges for carpet replacement and full repainting at final move-out, even after following earlier instructions. Earlier transfers within the complex reportedly went smoothly.

Package Lockers That Fill Up

When the parcel lockers reach capacity, drivers often leave packages in hallways. Some residents report stolen or missing items, with losses exceeding $300.

Uneven Staff Conduct

One tenant described a leasing employee knocking aggressively during a virtual court proceeding to warn of a fine over valet trash rules, while others reportedly broke the same rule without consequences. Reviews like this point to inconsistent rule enforcement.

Pearl Greenway Pros and Cons

ProsCons
Central Greenway-Upper Kirby locationSlow, inconsistent communication
Quartz kitchens, big windows, select studiesSome units not cleaned before move-in
Resort pool, cabanas, athletic clubCar break-ins and thefts in the garage
Same-day maintenance for many requestsPackage lockers overflow
Strong pet amenities and recycling pickupUnexpected move-out charges

How to Protect Yourself if You Lease at Pearl Greenway

  • Get everything in writing. Confirm lease terms, move-in date, and any concessions by email, not just by phone.
  • Do a move-in inspection. Photograph the unit, including blinds, cabinets, floors, and bathrooms, and submit the inventory form right away.
  • Ask about garage security. Find out how access is controlled, whether cameras cover the garage, and how incidents are communicated.
  • Plan your deliveries. Ask what happens when lockers are full and consider a pickup point for valuable packages.
  • Clarify move-out expectations. Ask what is considered normal wear and tear for carpet and paint before you sign.

Frequently Asked Questions

Where is Pearl Greenway located?

Pearl Greenway is at 3788 Richmond Ave., Houston, TX 77046, in the Greenway-Upper Kirby neighborhood.

What floor plans does Pearl Greenway offer?

One- and two-bedroom apartments ranging from 650 to 1,719 square feet.

Is Pearl Greenway pet-friendly?

Yes. It has a large gated dog park with play features, a splash fountain, and a wash station.

How is maintenance at Pearl Greenway?

Maintenance is one of the most praised areas, with many residents reporting same-day service for requests made early in the day.

Are there security concerns at Pearl Greenway?

Some residents reported car thefts and break-ins in the garage and were unhappy with how management handled them. Ask about current security measures when you tour.

Is Pearl Greenway Worth It?

For renters who prioritize a polished apartment, resort-style amenities, a pet-friendly setup, and a central location, Pearl Greenway still has real appeal, and helpful staff like Joanne and the maintenance crew earn genuine praise. Just go in prepared to advocate for yourself: visit more than once, test how fast the office responds, and document everything.

title: Remy on the Trails Reviews: Lakeside Living in West Houston
seo_title: Remy on the Trails Reviews: Pros, Cons & Tips
description: Remy on the Trails reviews praise the private lake, coworking lounge, and standout staff. Learn about parking and Building 1 issues before you choose a unit.
excerpt: Remy on the Trails, located in the West Houston area at 10421 Deerwood Rd, blends urban convenience with lakeside tranquility. With an impressive Google rating of 4.4 stars, this luxury apartment community offers studio, one-, and two-bedroom homes packed with upscale features and thoughtful design. Surrounded by green spaces and a private three-acre lake, Remy […]
content:
Remy on the Trails reviews are mostly glowing: residents rave about the private three-acre lake, the on-site coffee shop, modern finishes, and a staff that people name by name. The main complaints are limited free parking and recurring issues in Building 1, which sits closest to the tollway. At the time of publishing, this West Houston community at 10421 Deerwood Rd held a 4.4-star Google rating.

Here's a closer look at what residents love, where the property falls short, and how to pick the right unit.

Remy on the Trails at a glance

Remy on the Trails offers studio, one-, and two-bedroom homes surrounded by green space, walking trails, and easy access to Terry Hershey Park. It blends lakeside calm with quick access to West Houston shopping and dining, and it's a short drive from the Memorial City area.

DetailWhat the community offers
Address10421 Deerwood Rd, Houston (West Houston)
Google rating4.4 stars (at the time of publishing)
Floor plansStudio, 1 bedroom, 2 bedrooms
PetsCats and dogs, maximum of two; pet fee and monthly pet rent
AccessGated with 24-hour controlled access
ParkingLimited free parking; carports, garages, and EV charging at extra cost

What residents love about Remy on the Trails

Lakeside amenities and outdoor space

The community wraps around a private three-acre lake with a large dock for lounging, plus scenic walking trails and access to Terry Hershey Park. Outdoor living continues with three landscaped courtyards, fire pits, and grilling stations, and a resort-style pool with cabanas and a wet deck.

"The outdoor BBQ area and pool with a lake view are beautiful and perfect for relaxing."

The fitness center includes a virtual trainer and opens onto an outdoor exercise lawn.

Built for remote workers

The coworking lounge includes conference rooms and work pods, and managed Wi-Fi runs throughout the property. The resident lounge has cold brew on tap, and the on-site Slowpokes coffee shop is a favorite.

"The co-working space is a lifesaver for remote workers like me."

Stylish, practical apartments

Homes include:

  • Stainless steel appliances and quartz countertops
  • 42-inch wood cabinetry
  • Wood-look vinyl plank flooring throughout
  • Walk-in closets with wood shelving
  • In-unit washers and dryers
  • Smart keyless entry
  • Private patios or balconies in select units
  • Attached or detached garages, carports, and storage in select apartments

"The apartment itself has a clean, minimalistic, and modern design that I love."

Staff residents name by name

Team members like Tánia, Jordy, Jody, and Raul come up again and again for professionalism, warmth, and quick responses. Several residents say they renewed their leases because of the staff.

"Tánia and Jordy are absolute gems. Their dedication creates an environment that feels less like an apartment complex and more like a community."

Pet-friendly extras

There are two dog parks, one for small breeds and one for large dogs, plus a pet wash station.

"Dog owners will love the convenient walking trails around the property."

Community events

Regular social events help neighbors connect.

"The community events are fun, and the new cafe is a great addition."

Where Remy on the Trails falls short

Parking

Parking is the most common complaint, especially around Building 1. Paid options include attached and detached garages, carports, and private garages with EV charging, but free and guest spaces are limited and not always convenient.

"Parking is the only struggle really unless you pay for a parking spot. Just be ready to get creative."

"Parking is atrocious. You could end up circling for a while."

Building 1 maintenance issues

Multiple residents flagged problems specific to Building 1: frequent elevator outages, one lasting up to a month, and hallway A/C that failed in summer, causing trash odors. These don't appear to affect the whole property.

"Avoid renting from Building 1 entirely. The elevator goes out of service constantly."

Tollway noise

Building 1 is also closest to the tollway, and residents there report noticeable traffic noise day and night.

"Living in the first building puts you very close to the tollway and that results in LOTS of noise."

Pet waste

Some residents say irresponsible dog owners leave waste in shared areas. Other reviews note management stepped up monitoring and communication to address it.

"The only reason I can't give this place 5 stars is due to irresponsible dog owners."

Move-out billing

One former tenant said their final bill went to collections without notice despite giving a forwarding address, and it took months to sort out.

"They sent my final bill to collections without notifying me, even though I provided a forwarding address."

Pros and cons of Remy on the Trails

ProsCons
Private three-acre lake, trails, and Terry Hershey Park accessLimited free and guest parking
Coworking lounge and on-site coffee shopElevator and hallway A/C issues in Building 1
Modern finishes and in-unit washer/dryerTollway noise near Building 1
Highly praised staffOccasional pet waste complaints

title: Hanover River Oaks Reviews: Luxury High-Rise Pros and Cons
seo_title: Hanover River Oaks Reviews: Resident Pros & Cons
description: Hanover River Oaks reviews, summarized: standout amenities and staff in Upper Kirby, plus resident concerns about construction, elevators, and renewal hikes.
excerpt: Located at 2651 Kipling St, Houston, TX 77098, Hanover River Oaks is a premier luxury high-rise apartment community in the prestigious Upper Kirby neighborhood. Featuring 40 stories of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, including an exclusive penthouse level, Hanover River Oaks boasts a wide array of amenities designed to enhance urban living. With an impressive […]
content:
Hanover River Oaks reviews are mostly glowing, with a 4.8 Google rating at the time of writing, thanks to top-tier amenities, attentive staff, and a central Upper Kirby location. The critical reviews are specific, though: construction disruptions, long elevator waits, amenity closures, management turnover, and steep renewal increases.

Here is a balanced look at life in this 40-story luxury tower at 2651 Kipling St, Houston, TX 77098.

Disclaimer: These insights are based on Hanover River Oaks renter reviews gathered from Google and reflect personal experiences. The overall rating was accurate at the time of publishing.

Hanover River Oaks at a Glance

  • Address: 2651 Kipling St, Houston, TX 77098 (Upper Kirby)
  • Building: 40-story luxury high-rise
  • Floor plans: One-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, plus an exclusive penthouse level
  • Google rating: 4.8 at the time of writing
  • Pets: Pet-friendly, with a dog spa, grooming stations, and a dog run
  • Parking and services: Valet parking, concierge, and optional dry-cleaning valet

What Residents Love

Amenities and interior finishes

Residents highlight the elevated resort-style pool, a 24-hour fitness center with Peloton bikes and Olympic power racks, a private media room, a dog spa, and a virtual golf simulator. Coworking lounges and common areas are described as stylish, clean, and well kept. Inside the apartments, reviewers point to premium marble countertops, spacious walk-in closets, and chef-inspired kitchens.

Shared spaces also include a 9th-floor resident-only dining room and an outdoor sun terrace with multi-training systems and bocce ball courts.

Standout staff

Many reviews praise the team's professionalism and attentiveness, naming Regina Aquino, Genuice, Daniella, Trey, and Kevin in particular. From the front desk to the leasing office, residents describe personalized service and prompt help with requests.

A central location

Near Hwy 59 and I-610, the tower puts Downtown, the Museum District, and the Texas Medical Center within minutes. River Oaks Shopping Center, Highland Village, and the Galleria are close, and there is an H-E-B just across the street. Residents also like being able to walk to bars, cafes, and restaurants. For more options nearby, see our River Oaks apartments guide.

Pet- and family-friendly layouts

Pet owners appreciate the dog spa, grooming stations, and dog run. Families note the spacious layouts with large bedrooms and custom walk-in closets.

Strong first impressions on tours

Visitors describe a warm concierge team in the foyer, very clean common areas, and thorough tours of the pool deck, fitness center, media room, and golf simulator. Virtual tours are available for those who prefer to look remotely.

What Residents Criticize

Construction and maintenance

The most frequent complaint was a building-wide window replacement project. Residents reported restricted amenity access, obstructed views, steady noise, and unclear communication about timelines. Some also described delayed in-unit repairs, including ceiling leaks that raised mold concerns. These issues were especially hard on people working from home or sleeping during the day.

Elevator wait times

With elevators often tied up for construction and maintenance, residents reported waits of 10 to 15 minutes at peak hours, which is particularly tough with pets or young children.

Amenity closures

The pool, fitness center, and lounges sometimes closed unexpectedly due to construction or maintenance. Some residents mentioned repeated power outages affecting the pool and gym, and wear and tear with slow repairs.

Management turnover and communication

Residents described several changes in office staff during their leases, leading to inconsistent handling of requests and policies. Some felt newer management focused on cost cutting, with slow email replies and little transparency about construction.

Renewal increases

Several tenants reported renewal increases of more than $600 a month, which felt unjustified alongside construction and amenity issues. Some who renewed anyway said they regretted it.

Noise between units

Some reviews describe "paper-thin" walls, with neighbors' conversations, footsteps, and even sneezes audible.

Move-out charges

Former residents reported deposit deductions for items they considered normal wear and tear, such as small picture-hanger holes or light cabinet scratches.

Pros and Cons Summary

ProsCons
Elevated pool, 24-hour gym, media room, golf simulatorWindow replacement construction and noise
Highly praised concierge and staff10 to 15 minute elevator waits reported
Upper Kirby location with H-E-B across the streetUnexpected amenity closures
Dog spa, grooming stations, dog runManagement turnover and slow communication
Marble countertops and chef-inspired kitchensRenewal hikes over $600 and move-out disputes

Questions to Ask Before You Lease

  • Is construction still underway, and which floors or amenities does it affect?
  • How many elevators are in service right now?
  • Can you see a unit on a similar floor to the one you would rent, and listen for noise?
  • What were typical renewal increases last year?
  • What does the move-out checklist count as normal wear and tear? Take dated photos at move-in.

Frequently Asked Questions

Where is Hanover River Oaks located?

At 2651 Kipling St, Houston, TX 77098, in the Upper Kirby neighborhood near Hwy 59 and I-610.

What apartment sizes does Hanover River Oaks offer?

One-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, plus an exclusive penthouse level.

Is Hanover River Oaks pet-friendly?

Yes. It offers a dog spa, grooming stations, and a dog run.

What is the main complaint from residents?

The most frequent complaints are construction disruptions, elevator waits, and amenity closures, followed by management turnover and renewal increases.

Are virtual tours available?

Yes, virtual tours are offered for prospective residents.

Comparing Upper Kirby High-Rises?

Hanover River Oaks can be a stunning home if the construction and service issues residents describe have been resolved, so tour in person and ask direct questions. title: Hanover Autry Park Reviews: Luxury High-Rise Living in Houston
seo_title: Hanover Autry Park Reviews | Houston Apartments
description: Hanover Autry Park reviews: residents praise the staff, rooftop infinity pool and Buffalo Bayou location, with a few noise and pest concerns. Read more here.
excerpt: Located in the heart of Houston at 811 Buffalo Park Drive, Hanover Autry Park rises 24 stories above the city skyline, offering a new standard of luxury living. Home to 324 beautifully appointed residences, this high-rise sits in the walkable and scenic Autry Park District—Houston’s newest urban village along Buffalo Bayou. Residents enjoy proximity to […]
content:
Hanover Autry Park reviews are overwhelmingly positive, with residents praising standout staff, resort-level amenities and a walkable spot along Buffalo Bayou. The 24-story tower at 811 Buffalo Park Drive held a 5.0-star overall Google rating at the time of writing, though a couple of reviews flag real concerns worth knowing about.

Here is what residents say, what the building offers and how to decide if it is the right high-rise for you.

Hanover Autry Park at a glance

Hanover Autry Park rises 24 stories with 324 residences in the Autry Park District, a walkable urban village along Buffalo Bayou. Homes feature chef-styled kitchens, spa-inspired bathrooms, floor-to-ceiling windows and private terraces, many with downtown Houston views.

DetailWhat we found
Address811 Buffalo Park Drive, Houston
Building24-story high-rise, 324 residences
Floor plansStudio, one-, two- and three-bedroom, including penthouses
Signature amenityRooftop infinity pool with downtown views
ServicesValet parking, 24/7 concierge, dry-cleaning lockers
PetsPet-friendly, with a pet spa and dog park
Google rating5.0 stars at the time of writing

What residents love about Hanover Autry Park

Outstanding, personal service

From leasing to concierge and valet teams, residents consistently describe staff as warm, professional and attentive. Mohammed, Hunter, Blake, Crystal Egan and Sami come up again and again.

One resident shared that the team took care of her after surgery so she never had to lift even a small package. It is a good example of Hanover’s brand promise to “Make Life Easy.”

Premier amenities and design

Residents compare the amenities to a five-star resort:

  • Expansive rooftop infinity pool with sweeping downtown views
  • 24-hour fitness center with Echelon smart bikes and Reflect Mirror
  • Media room, coworking lounge and resident bar
  • 24th-floor outdoor lounge with a floating fireplace, grilling stations and firepits
  • Fully equipped catering kitchen and private meeting rooms
  • Pet spa with grooming stations

Chef-styled kitchens and spa-like bathrooms

Kitchens include premium appliance packages, Italian soft-close cabinetry, granite or quartz countertops, and smart home features like app-controlled thermostats and USB charging outlets. Select homes add built-in desks, bookcases and private terraces with views of downtown or the nearby park.

Bathrooms are a resident favorite, with large soaking tubs, walk-in showers, double vanities and linen closets.

A walkable location by Buffalo Bayou Park

The building sits along Buffalo Bayou, next to Buffalo Bayou Park, which makes it a great fit for runners, dog owners and anyone who wants green space at the door. Residents can walk to restaurants like Annabelle’s, Auden, MF Sushi and Turner’s Cut steakhouse, plus boutiques and salons. Pet owners get a dedicated dog park and a grooming spa.

Community and lifestyle perks

Reviewers mention genuine camaraderie between residents and staff, private events and social gatherings. Valet parking, dry-cleaning lockers and round-the-clock concierge service make daily life easier.

A smooth leasing and tour process

Several people said arriving felt like checking into a “5-star resort.” Hunter and Blake get high marks for friendliness and product knowledge, and tours are described as seamless and tailored. Some residents applied on the spot.

Fast maintenance and spotless common areas

Residents commend maintenance for quick, thorough work, even on minor issues. Common areas are described as spotless and pleasantly fragrant.

Concerns raised in Hanover Autry Park reviews

A severe pest incident

One resident moved into an apartment with fire ants coming from the baseboards and walls. An allergic reaction led to an emergency room visit, and the resident stayed in a hotel for a month at their own cost because no temporary housing was offered. Sealing the baseboards eventually fixed the problem, but the resident felt unsupported by the lack of timely communication or compensation.

Ongoing construction noise

Another resident cited a high-rise under construction next to the west side of the building, with noise from early morning into the evening. That was especially hard for someone working from home. They also raised pedestrian and cyclist safety concerns about opaque construction fencing creating blind spots, and said months of feedback to management went unanswered.

Pros and cons

ProsCons
Highly praised, personal staffConstruction noise next to the west side (per one resident)
Rooftop infinity pool and resort-style amenitiesOne serious fire ant incident with limited support
Walkable to Buffalo Bayou Park, dining and shopsSome feedback to management went unanswered
Valet, concierge and dry-cleaning lockers

Tips for touring Hanover Autry Park

  • Ask which side of the building a unit faces and whether nearby construction is still active.
  • Tour during weekday working hours if you work from home, so you hear what a typical day sounds like.
  • Ask how the team handles pest issues and what happens if a unit becomes temporarily unlivable.
  • Confirm valet parking costs and how guest parking works.

Comparing towers? Our guide to luxury high-rise apartments in Houston is a helpful next read.

Frequently asked questions

Where is Hanover Autry Park?

It is at 811 Buffalo Park Drive in Houston, in the Autry Park District near Buffalo Bayou.

What floor plans are available?

Studio, one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, including penthouse residences.

Is Hanover Autry Park pet-friendly?

Yes. It has a pet spa with grooming stations and a dog park, and Buffalo Bayou Park is right next door.

Is Hanover Autry Park good for remote work?

It has a coworking lounge and private meeting rooms, and many apartments include built-in desks. Ask about nearby construction if quiet daytime hours matter to you.

Is parking available?

Yes, valet parking is available along with 24/7 concierge service.

Is Hanover Autry Park worth it?

For renters who want exceptional service, resort-style amenities and walkable access to Buffalo Bayou Park, the reviews make a strong case. The concerns are limited but real, so ask about construction and pest response before you sign.

title: Everly Apartments Reviews: Smart-Home Luxury, Real Trade-Offs
seo_title: Everly Apartments Reviews: Pros, Cons & Safety
description: Everly Apartments reviews: smart-home features and resort amenities near the Galleria, plus the security, elevator, and towing issues to ask about.
excerpt: Located in the heart of Houston and conveniently nestled within the beltway, Everly Apartments boasts modern smart-home living with luxury 1 and 2-bedroom apartments and townhomes. Minutes away from the Galleria, Houston Community College, top restaurants, and nightlife, Everly Apartments has earned a solid 4.1-star Google rating reviews. But does the experience live up to […]
content:
Everly Apartments reviews give this smart-home community at 2827 Dunvale Rd high marks for its interiors, amenities, and friendly staff, along with a 4.1-star Google rating at the time of writing. The trade-off, according to many residents, has been theft in the parking areas, elevator outages, hallway cleanliness, and aggressive guest towing, though recent reviews point to improvements. Here is a clear look at both sides so you can decide whether Everly belongs on your tour list.

Note: This summary is based on renter experiences shared in public Google reviews. The 4.1-star rating was accurate at the time of posting and may change as new reviews are added.

Everly Apartments at a glance

Everly sits inside the Beltway, minutes from the Galleria area, Houston Community College, and plenty of restaurants and nightlife. It offers luxury one- and two-bedroom apartments as well as townhomes, all built around smart-home technology.

DetailWhat we found
Address2827 Dunvale Rd, Houston, TX 77063
Home types1- and 2-bedroom apartments, plus townhomes
Google rating4.1 stars at the time of writing
PetsPet-friendly, with a dog park and dog wash station
Guest parkingLimited; vehicles must be registered in a smart parking app

What residents love about Everly Apartments

Upscale interiors

The apartments themselves are the most consistent bright spot in Everly Apartments reviews. Features residents mention include:

  • Chef-inspired kitchens with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, a farmhouse sink, and a large island
  • Vinyl plank flooring and built-in bookshelves
  • Double-sink vanities and soaking tubs
  • Walk-in closets and linen storage in select units
  • Built-in desks and in-sink disposals

"The apartment itself is stunning... truly a pleasure to live in."

Smart-home convenience

Everly leans heavily into connected living. Homes include keyless smart locks, smart thermostats, self-monitored alarm service, smart leak sensors, and complimentary smart plugs, all controlled through one app that also handles lighting and door access. Tech-savvy residents call this out often.

"I loved all these smart home features... so convenient to use from the app."

Resort-style amenities

The amenity list goes well beyond the basics:

  • Resort-style swimming pool and sundeck
  • Yoga studio, spin bikes, and a spacious gym
  • Putting green, clubhouse, and courtyard
  • Fire pit and grilling station
  • Coworking space, business center, conference room, and coffee bar
  • A Zen room for quiet relaxation
  • Valet waste service

"The pool is very spacious, and so is the gym. The apartments are great quality and rich in amenities."

If a strong fitness setup is high on your list, our Houston apartments with a gym search is a good place to compare.

Pet-friendly living

Pet owners appreciate the large dog park, the dog wash station, yard games, open green spaces, and shared outdoor patios. For residents with active pets, Everly is a welcoming spot. Compare it with other Houston apartments with a pet wash station if that perk matters to you.

Responsive leasing and maintenance

Many residents praise the leasing team, with Thalia and Katie mentioned by name, and several commend the maintenance crew's quick response times.

"Maintenance requests are handled promptly. The staff solves the problem quickly."

Common complaints in Everly Apartments reviews

Despite the luxury features, a recurring theme runs through the critical reviews: security and upkeep.

Theft and break-ins

Residents report car wheel theft, vehicle break-ins, patio thefts, and even home burglaries, some within weeks of moving in. Several note there were no security cameras in the parking areas.

"My apartment was burglarized in broad daylight."

"My vehicle was stripped of its wheels and there were no cameras in the parking lot."

How management handled safety

Some reviewers felt their concerns were brushed off. One said a manager described a vehicle theft as "normal in Houston," which did little to build trust.

"No empathy from management. They basically shrugged it off."

Hallway cleanliness and pests

Even with valet waste service and a Pure Air community initiative, residents describe foul-smelling hallways, especially on weekends, trash bags left by stairwells, pet accidents, and ants and roaches.

"Hallways stink and bags are left leaking for days... roaches in the hallways."

Elevators, water shutoffs, and gates

Several residents report elevator outages lasting weeks, in some cases up to a month. Water shutoffs during heavy rain have also affected buildings for hours or days, and the security gates are reportedly often broken.

"The elevator is constantly down. Trash piles up. It's a nightmare."

Guest parking and towing

Visitor parking is limited, and any car not registered through the smart parking app is at high risk of being towed. Multiple residents say friends and family were towed, sometimes repeatedly.

"My family is terrified to visit me. Their car got towed three times."

Signs of improvement

Not all recent feedback is critical. One resident who first complained about security and cleanliness later updated their review to note a new courtesy officer and a more proactive management team. Others mention faster maintenance and better communication from the leasing office. Trash misuse and some hallway issues reportedly persist, but the trend is encouraging.

"New employees and manager are awesome... safety and cleanliness concerns are being rectified."

Everly Apartments pros and cons

ProsCons
Stunning interiors with chef-inspired kitchensReports of car and home break-ins
Extensive smart-home featuresElevator outages lasting weeks
Pool, putting green, Zen room, and coworking spaceDirty hallways and pest complaints
Pet-friendly with a dog park and dog washStrict towing and limited visitor parking
Praised leasing and maintenance staffUnreliable security gates

Tips before you lease at Everly

  • Ask whether cameras or patrols now cover the parking areas and whether the courtesy officer is still on site.
  • Visit on a weekend evening to see hallway and trash conditions for yourself.
  • If you are considering an upper floor, ask how elevator outages have been handled recently.
  • Have the leasing office walk you through the guest parking app so visitors know exactly how to register.
  • Talk to a current resident or two if you get the chance.

Frequently asked questions

Is Everly Apartments safe?

Some residents report theft and break-ins, while others note recent improvements such as a courtesy officer. Safety is the top concern in reviews, so ask what measures are currently in place.

What smart-home features does Everly include?

Homes come with keyless smart locks, smart thermostats, smart leak sensors, self-monitored alarm service, complimentary smart plugs, and app control for lighting, temperature, and door access.

Is Everly Apartments pet-friendly?

Yes. It has a large dog park, a dog wash station, and open green spaces. Some reviews mention pet-related cleanliness issues in hallways.

How does guest parking work?

Visitor spots are limited, and guests must be registered through the smart parking app. Towing is strictly enforced for unregistered vehicles.

Does Everly offer townhomes?

Yes. Along with one- and two-bedroom apartments, Everly offers townhomes. If you want more space, see our guide to townhomes for rent in Houston.

Our verdict on Everly Apartments

Everly is undeniably beautiful, with standout kitchens, a full smart-home package, and resort-style amenities. If stylish, tech-forward living is your priority and recent security improvements hold, it could be a strong choice. If peace of mind and spotless common areas are non-negotiable, tour in person and ask pointed questions first.

title: Lumen Apartments Reviews: The Good and Bad at 2400 W Dallas
seo_title: Lumen Apartments Reviews: Honest Pros & Cons
description: Lumen Apartments reviews from Houston residents: a prime Buffalo Bayou location and sleek units, but security, noise and upkeep issues. Know before you tour.
excerpt: Located at 2400 W Dallas St in the heart of Houston, TX, Lumen Apartments offers modern layouts, sleek amenities, and a coveted location near Buffalo Bayou Park. With an overall Google rating of 3.7, the apartment complex receives mixed reviews from its tenants. While some highlight the community’s upscale vibe and responsive staff, others raise […]
content:
Lumen Apartments reviews are sharply mixed: residents love the location near Buffalo Bayou Park and the modern finishes, but many report problems with security, cleanliness, noise, and management. The community at 2400 W Dallas St, Houston, TX 77019 held a 3.7-star Google rating at the time of writing.

Here is a clear breakdown of what tenants praise, what they complain about, and the questions worth asking before you sign a lease.

Lumen Apartments at a Glance

Lumen markets itself as “an elevated residence for those who want to live a little brighter,” aimed at urbanites who want shopping, dining, and entertainment in every direction.

DetailLumen Apartments
Address2400 W Dallas St, Houston, TX 77019
NearbyBuffalo Bayou Park, downtown, Montrose, River Oaks Shopping Center
Interior finishesVinyl plank floors, quartz countertops, matte tile backsplashes, Thermofoil or textured cabinetry
AmenitiesResort-inspired pool, two-story fitness center, sky lounge, clubhouse, dog spa, dog park, WeWork-style lounges, conference rooms
Google rating3.7 stars at the time of writing

What Residents Like About Lumen Apartments

Caring leasing staff

Team members including Selest, Nancy, Melinda, and Salestria are named repeatedly for being professional, transparent, and genuinely invested in residents.

“The front staff Nancy and Melinda and everyone else have been wonderful. They treat us like family and are very transparent.”

“Salestria truly cares about the residents of Lumen. She informs the residents what is actually being done.”

A location that is hard to beat

Lumen sits near Buffalo Bayou, close to downtown Houston, and within walking distance of Whole Foods, River Oaks Shopping Center, and dining in Montrose. Buffalo Bayou Park’s trails are about five minutes north, the Toyota Center is to the east, and multiple freeway connections are nearby.

“The location and the layout cannot be beaten.”

Upscale amenities

The pool, sky lounge with downtown views, two-story gym, dog spa, and coworking lounges cover a lot of lifestyles. Residents who use the gym say it is well equipped.

“The gym was great, other than its location. It had a lot of great equipment.”

“My 2 bedroom 2 bath is really nice. The vibes are so chill.”

Modern interiors

Vinyl plank flooring, quartz countertops, and matte tile backsplashes give units a contemporary look that residents appreciate on move-in.

“Everything is updated (they are fairly new).”

Helpful individual maintenance techs

Even residents frustrated with the building often single out maintenance workers as courteous and dependable, despite a heavy workload.

“The maintenance man was always extremely helpful and very kind.”

Common Complaints in Lumen Apartments Reviews

Security gaps

This is the most frequent concern. Residents describe garage gates broken for months, entrances where keyless access failed, and package lockers in the garage with no cameras.

“Garage gates have been broken for months and they will not even provide 24-hour security.”

“Parcel lockers are outside in the garage with no cameras.”

Cleanliness and pests

Reviewers mention overflowing trash rooms, odors, stained hallway carpets, dirty elevators, and rodent problems, including traps left in a utility closet.

“Trash piled up daily in trash area. Elevators and floors are not being cleaned regularly.”

Thin walls and noise

Many tenants say they can hear neighbors clearly, from footsteps to late-night music, which is especially hard for people who work from home or keep unusual hours.

“My new neighbor plays music at 3 am. No reminders from management.”

Management turnover and communication

Some residents report the office staff changing about every two months, unanswered emails and calls, and a locked office door during business hours.

“No amount of emails, office visits, and phone calls seems to provoke any action.”

Amenities that are not always working

Reviewers cite elevators left padded for long stretches, package lockers out of order, and a fire alarm that went off repeatedly for months.

“Package lockers are constantly out of order.”

Health concerns

A few reviews describe serious issues, including rodent droppings found shortly after move-in and one tenant who attributed a hospital stay for lung inflammation to the building’s air quality.

Lease terms, fees, and parking

  • One renter said a promised two months free on a 12-month lease became a last-minute 13-month lease.
  • Others reported unexplained fees on monthly statements that were hard to get corrected.
  • Unclear parking signage led to towing threats, even in unmarked spaces.

Questions about review authenticity

One reviewer pointed to a sudden burst of short 5-star reviews posted within a few hours and questioned whether they were genuine, which is worth keeping in mind when reading the overall rating.

“We are to believe that 19 people were spontaneously overwhelmed by love for Lumen, all within a few hours?”

Pros and Cons Summary

ProsCons
Central location near Buffalo Bayou, downtown, and MontroseBroken gates and unsecured package lockers
Modern finishes like quartz and vinyl plankCleanliness and rodent complaints
Pool, sky lounge, two-story gym, dog spaThin walls and noise
Several well-liked staff and maintenance techsOffice turnover and slow responses

Should You Rent at Lumen Apartments?

On paper, Lumen checks many boxes: sleek interiors, a long amenity list, and a location near some of Houston’s best destinations. Resident experiences are more complicated, and the 3.7-star rating reflects real, recurring problems.

If you are considering Lumen, tour beyond the model unit. Walk the garage, check whether the gates and lockers work, look at the trash rooms and hallways, and ask about maintenance turnaround and security plans. Get any move-in special and lease length in writing before you sign. If you want similar access with stronger reviews, compare options in River Oaks and nearby neighborhoods.

This article is based on 16 public Google reviews and reflects individual resident experiences. The 3.7-star rating was accurate at the time of writing and may change.

Frequently asked questions

Where is Lumen Apartments located?

At 2400 W Dallas St, Houston, TX 77019, near Buffalo Bayou Park and minutes from downtown, with shopping, dining, and major freeways close by.

What amenities does Lumen offer?

A resort-style pool, two-story fitness center, sky lounge with downtown views, clubhouse, dog spa, social lounge, conference rooms, and WeWork-inspired spaces. Some reviews say upkeep is inconsistent.

Is security a concern at Lumen Apartments?

Many residents say so, citing broken garage gates, unsecured entry points, malfunctioning package lockers, and limited visible surveillance.

Is management responsive?

Feedback is mixed. Individual staff members get praise, but many reviews mention frequent turnover and difficulty getting complaints resolved.

Our Take on Cityscape Apartments

content:
88twenty reviews mostly split along one line: residents rave about the responsive staff, fast maintenance, and upscale kitchens, while critics point to safety incidents, worn common areas, and surprise fees. At the time of writing, 88twenty Apartment Homes at 8820 Westheimer Rd held a 3.5-star Google rating. Here’s the good and the bad from real renters, plus what to ask before you sign.

88twenty at a Glance

Detail88twenty Apartment Homes
Address8820 Westheimer Rd, Houston, TX 77063
AreaUptown / West Houston, near Piney Point Village
Floor plansStudio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom
Google rating3.5 stars (at the time of writing)
PetsUp to two pets; breed restrictions and pet fees apply
School districtHouston ISD

Apartment Features at 88twenty

Floor plans are open-concept with plank-style wood flooring and built-in buffets in select homes. Interior features include:

  • Stainless steel Whirlpool appliances
  • Quartz countertops in kitchens and baths
  • White subway tile backsplashes
  • Kitchen islands with countertop seating (select units)
  • Walk-in closets and private balconies
  • Soaking tubs and standing showers (select units)
  • Full-size washer and dryer in every unit
  • Designer pendant lighting and oversized windows

The Good: What Residents Appreciate About 88twenty

Professional, Responsive Leasing Team

Many tenants single out staff members like Stephanie, Breanna, Gabe, and Alicia, describing the leasing office as warm and helpful from the first tour through move-in and beyond. One reviewer wrote, “From the moment I moved in, they’ve been highly responsive and professional.” Others said staff answered questions thoroughly and reassured hesitant applicants.

Fast, Friendly Maintenance

Maintenance is a standout in 88twenty reviews. One resident said a broken A/C was fixed within a few hours in the summer, and others reported plumbing and appliance issues handled the same day. Reviewers also describe the team as courteous and respectful when entering their homes.

Quiet Units and Smart Layouts

Despite the busy Westheimer Road frontage, many residents say sound insulation keeps outside noise down, especially in courtyard-facing units. That matters to people who work from home or have young children. Open layouts, large windows, and practical storage make the units feel roomy, and the kitchens are a favorite for home cooks and hosts.

Amenities Residents Use

  • Fully equipped fitness center
  • Outdoor swimming pool and landscaped courtyards
  • Resident lounge with a pool table
  • Gated garage parking
  • Parcel box system and secured mailroom
  • On-site dog walking area and resident events

Convenient Uptown Location

88twenty sits in the Uptown and Galleria area, minutes from the Galleria Mall and attractions like the Houston Zoo, Memorial Park, and the Arboretum. Major highways are close by, and Houston Baptist University is about 11 minutes away.

The Bad: Common Complaints in 88twenty Reviews

Noise and Weak Follow-Up

Some residents report problems with upstairs neighbors and barking dogs, in a few cases allegedly from staff members themselves, and say their complaints were ignored.

Safety Concerns

Reviewers mention break-ins, vandalism, and incidents near the property. Management has posted guards at the entrances, but several residents call the measures more performative than effective. One tenant described residents being told to shelter in place because of a suspicious armed person. Others cite recurring car burglaries in the garage and loitering near entrances, partly blaming the nearby gas station, and want better lighting, stricter access control, and faster response.

Worn Common Areas

Several tenants describe smelly hallways, stained carpets, and common-area renovations left unfinished for months. Unreliable elevators and garage doors that malfunction or stay open come up too, which is a real hassle for residents with mobility needs or heavy loads.

Move-Out Charges and Admin Fees

At least two reviews warn of unexpected costs. One former tenant said they were charged $6,700 in fees after moving out and called the charges vague. A prospective tenant said the community kept a non-refundable admin fee even though the application didn’t go through.

Emergency Communication

Some residents say communication during incidents like flooding or fire alarms has been inconsistent.
